title.zh-CN: 皮肤渐黑与身材矮小 · 13岁男孩
title.en: Progressive dark skin and short stature · boy aged 13

summary.zh-CN: 儿童期出现的皮肤、面貌与生长变化，需要结合糖代谢及遗传证据。
summary.en: Childhood skin, facial and growth changes require metabolic and genetic correlation.

prompt.zh-CN: 哪些特点要求超越单纯肥胖相关糖尿病？
prompt.en: Which findings require looking beyond ordinary obesity-related diabetes?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 幼年起病的综合征性胰岛素受体异常
text.en: A childhood-onset syndromic insulin-receptor disorder

feedback.zh-CN: 生长、皮肤、牙舌和生殖器改变需要统一解释。
feedback.en: Growth, skin, dental, tongue and genital findings need a unifying explanation.

text.zh-CN: 仅青春期肥胖可解释全部表现
text.en: Pubertal obesity alone explains all findings

feedback.zh-CN: 生长落后及幼年起病并非这一解释所能涵盖。
feedback.en: Early onset and growth failure are not accounted for.

text.zh-CN: 没有多尿可排除糖代谢异常
text.en: Absence of polyuria excludes dysglycaemia

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 表型与父母来源不同的INSR变异支持Rabson–Mendenhall谱系
text.en: Phenotype and variants inherited from different parents support the Rabson–Mendenhall spectrum

feedback.zh-CN: 家系来源增强解释力，但原文未提供功能实验。
feedback.en: Segregation strengthens interpretation, although functional studies are unavailable.

text.zh-CN: 父母表型正常使遗传病不可能
text.en: Normal parental phenotypes exclude inherited disease

feedback.zh-CN: 隐性遗传携带者可表型正常。
feedback.en: Recessive carriers may have normal phenotypes.

text.zh-CN: 一次胰岛素值即可判断长期分泌能力
text.en: One insulin value establishes long-term secretory capacity

feedback.zh-CN: 需结合血糖、病程及后续动态评估。
feedback.en: Glucose, course and longitudinal assessment are needed.

prompt.zh-CN: 如何制定后续安全计划？
prompt.en: What is a safe follow-up plan?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 儿内分泌与遗传团队评估血糖风险、生长及家庭支持
text.en: Endocrine and genetic teams should assess glycaemic risk, growth and family support

feedback.zh-CN: 避免由单例自行外推药物或剂量，并关注受嘲笑的影响。
feedback.en: Avoid extrapolated self-treatment and address the impact of teasing.

text.zh-CN: 无口渴就不必监测血糖
text.en: No thirst means glucose monitoring is unnecessary

feedback.zh-CN: 症状缺如不能否认生化异常。
feedback.en: Absent symptoms do not negate biochemical disease.

text.zh-CN: 基因确诊意味着已有根治药
text.en: Genetic confirmation means a curative drug is established

feedback.zh-CN: 报告没有给出这种治疗证据。
feedback.en: The report supplies no such treatment evidence.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：识别黑棘皮病伴生长障碍的综合征线索。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：功能实验、后续血糖轨迹、治疗及长期随访。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Identify syndromic clues in acanthosis with growth failure. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: Functional studies, subsequent glycaemia, treatment and long-term follow-up. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 幼年皮肤、生长和糖代谢异常结合INSR家系变异支持Rabson–Mendenhall综合征。
conclusion.en: Childhood skin, growth and glycaemic abnormalities with segregating INSR variants support Rabson–Mendenhall syndrome.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.
